model.title: A resolution to authorize testimony, document production, and representation by the Senate Legal Counsel in the case of United States v. Terry.

summary.text: The resolution would authorize the Senate Legal Counsel to provide testimony, produce documents, and represent the Senate in a court case involving the United States and an individual named Terry.
